# VeneHire

> VeneHire trains and evaluates software engineers, then matches them with companies that need
> production-ready talent without the ramp-up time of a traditional hire.

## Pages

- [Home](https://venehire.vercel.app/): Overview of the platform for companies and engineers.
- [About](https://venehire.vercel.app/about): How the training and evaluation program works.
- [Browse Talent](https://venehire.vercel.app/talent): Public directory of vetted engineers.
- [Request Access](https://venehire.vercel.app/request-sign-up): Apply as a company or as an engineer.
- [Contact](https://venehire.vercel.app/contact): Get in touch with the VeneHire team.
